title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
authors: Amey Agrawal; Jayashree Mohan; Nipun Kwatra; Bhargav Gulavani; Alexey Tumanov
venue_full: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems face a throughput-latency tradeoff where prefill-prioritizing schedulers improve throughput but cause generation stalls, while decode-prioritizing schedulers optimize latency but suffer from low throughput.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務系統面臨 throughput-latency 的取捨困境：優先 prefill 的 scheduler 可提升 throughput，但會造成生成停滯；而優先 decode 的 scheduler 雖能優化 latency，卻導致 throughput 偏低。

key_innovation.en: Sarathi-Serve introduces chunked-prefills to split prompt processing into smaller compute units and stall-free scheduling to coalesce these chunks with ongoing decodes, minimizing latency impact while maximizing GPU utilization.
key_innovation.zh: Sarathi-Serve 引入 chunked-prefill，將 prompt 處理拆分為更小的計算單元，並以無停滯排程將這些 chunk 與進行中的 decode 合批，在最大化 GPU 利用率的同時將 latency 影響降至最低。

key_improvements.en: Up to 3.7x higher serving capacity for Yi-34B, 2.6x for Mistral-7B, and 5.6x gain in end-to-end serving capacity for Falcon-180B.
key_improvements.zh: Yi-34B 的服務容量最高提升 3.7x，Mistral-7B 提升 2.6x，Falcon-180B 的端到端服務容量提升 5.6x。
